description: This Swift source file defines the GatewayDiscoveryModel class, responsible for discovering, managing, and logging the state of network gateways using Bonjour/multicast DNS. It includes data structures for representing log entries and gateway information, as well as methods for starting/stopping discovery, updating states, and handling external dependencies.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: A final class responsible for discovering and managing network gateways, providing debugging logs, and updating internal state based on network events.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DebugLogEntry
classes.description: A struct representing a log entry with timestamp and message for debugging purposes.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: A struct representing a network gateway with properties such as name, endpoint, identifiers, ports, TLS info, and optional CLI path.

methods.name: setDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging, clearing logs if disabled or appending initial logs when enabled.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins network discovery by creating and starting browser objects for specified domains.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing network discovery, cancels browsers, and resets internal state.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Recomputes the list of discovered gateways by consolidating results from all domains, detecting additions/removals, and updating the list.

methods.name: updateStatusText
methods.description: Updates the status text based on current network states and whether browsers are active.

methods.name: prettyState
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string for a given NWBrowser.State.

methods.name: appendDebugLog
methods.description: Adds a message to the debug log with timestamp if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: prettifyInstanceName
methods.description: Normalizes and cleans up gateway instance names for display.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts a trimmed string value from a dictionary for a given key, returning nil if empty.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Converts a string value from a dictionary to an integer for a given key.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Parses a boolean value from a string in a dictionary for a given key.
